Name: Maggs Immersive Sebastian Romance Authors Choice Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b]NOTE[/b]: This version of the mod is NOT PolyAmory or DSV compatible. Please use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Immersive Sebastian Romance Core[/url] for compatibility. All versions are DSV compatible, the Lite version is PolyAmory compatible.

[b]DISCLAIMER FOR WRITING STYLE
[/b]The dialogue in this mod is written informally and according to common speech patterns, so it is NOT always grammatically correct. Words may be dropped, conjunctions skipped, and improper words used. Formal grammar is not natural speech and sounds forced and flat when used for dialogue.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Story and event heavy mod.
[list]
[*]The story paced over 2 1/2 years (minimum), this is a long-form story and the farmer's relationship with Sebastian unfolds at a relaxed pace.[/*]
[*]A new save is required to see all the content[/*]
[*]Sebastian starts out as non-romaceable to keep the pace correct and avoid having to worry about his heart level[/*]
[*]Includes reverse confession and proposal, along with a custom wedding[/*]
[/list]
This all-in-one version does not require the Maggs Immersive Sebastian Romance Core and is a completely separate mod. It is like an ongoing beta, new content will be added to this mod first, and when it's stable, added to the core and expansions.
[list]
[*]All the newest content but fewer configuration options. I will not add additional config options to this mod, swap to the Core + Spicy Expansion if you want other choices.[/*]
[*]Won't run if the Core or Spicy Expansion mod is installed to avoid game-breaking conflicts (since people tend to install everything)[/*]
[*]Since this is the "cutting edge" mod, it will break poly (or any relationship game mechanic-changing) saves so it won't run if those mods are installed to avoid ruining anyone's save. [/*]
[*][b]Highly recommended to start a new save[/b], I can't guarantee there won't be issues if you're using an older save, especially if you had a prior Sebastian relationship.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218459.png[/img]
If you're coming from Immersive Sebastian:
Author's Choice is for people who normally choose these settings (they are not config options):
[list]
[*]Spicy + Mature[/*]
[*]Slow Burn[/*]
[*]Farmer learns magic (only a few events are affected by this choice)[/*]
[*]Spectrum yes[/*]
[*]Farmer first person[/*]
[*]Quit smoking[/*]
[*]Custom wedding[/*]
[*]Splash Art enabled[/*]
[/list]
Options available on Author's Choice:
[list]
[*]Female/Male farmer (based on your choice when you create your character, no neutral option)[/*]
[*]Turn on/off Sebastian's bedroom and outdoor decor[/*]
[*]Select the frequency of Sleepover, Pillowtalk, Good Morning, and Marriage Date events[/*]
[*]Choice of endearment nickname[/*]
[*]Turn on/off event custom sprites[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]

Sprite mods
All sprite mods are compatible, but these are preferred and have the custom sprites included.
(keep the config as [b]Custom Event Sprites = yes[/b], no other action needed)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites and Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30278]Heart-pounding Sebastian Sprites[/url] [i]Thanks to Chestnuts18 for adding the custom sprites in her style!
[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] [i]Thanks to AirynS for adding the Sebastian sprites in DSV style!
[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits Cuter[/url] PLUS [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29689]Maggs Custom Sprite Patch for Seasonal Outfits and Nyapu[/url]﻿ (both must have Sebastian enabled)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]Seasonal Nyapu Portraits[/url]﻿ PLUS [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29689]Maggs Custom Sprite Patch for Seasonal Outfits and Nyapu[/url]﻿ (both must have Sebastian enabled)

[b]Compatible Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village[/*]
[*]East Scarpe[/*]
[*]Sunberry (other than the Wren character story, it changes Sebastian's history and is not story-compatible)[/*]
[*]Maggs Alex and Sam Friendship mods[/*]
[*]Wandering Spouses[/*]
[/list]
[b]Incompatible Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*]Maggs Immersive Sam and Immersive Alex, ﻿Author's Choice mod is not poly-play compatible so use their Friendship mods[/*]
[*]Fast Events (a selection in Faster Animations) this setting must be set to 1 or it will break my events[/*]
[*]Less Ugly Town Interiors for the Wizard's tower and Carpenter's shop (turn these locations off, otherwise events will break)[/*]
[*]Any mod that changes the maps entirely for the Carpenter's shop or Wizard's tower[/*]
[*]Polyamory Sweet[/*]
[*]DSV (note: Technically compatible, this mod will not conflict in SMAPI, however, not character compatible. This mod makes no mention of any gender variants or neutral pronouns, splash art is similar to vanilla Sebastian)[/*]
[*]Marry Me (﻿Author's Choice mod includes Seb's reverse confession and proposal)[/*]
[*]Any mod that changes the Wedding event {﻿Author's Choice mod has a custom wedding)[/*]
[*]Horny Bachelors (sprite conflict)[/*]
[*]Any genderswap mods or sprites for obvious reasons[/*]
[/list]
